Flight · Greece

Greece reports three Turkish UAVs and three airspace violations on 26 October

26 October 2026 · Northeastern / southeastern Aegean · Greek-reported Turkish UAVs

Greek-authority-reported Turkish UAV airspace violations

The GEETHA-attributed account for 26 October lists three Turkish UAVs, three national-airspace violations and one UAV FIR infringement in the northeastern and southeastern Aegean. Two further FIR infringements concern a manned ATR-72, not drones.

NewsIT and OnAlert reproduce the same official account rather than independent observations. Identification and interception were reported, without armed engagement. This is one daily-activity record, not a sum of aircraft and crossing counts.

Attribution and uncertainty

Origin / operator / attribution
Turkish military attribution and national-airspace assessment are those of Greek authorities. The Greek-Turkish airspace dispute remains relevant.
Investigation / uncertainty
NewsIT and OnAlert reproduce one GEETHA account, not independent observations. The original bulletin was not retrieved directly. Exact tracks, times and models remain unknown; airspace assessment is attributed to Greece.
